_comments.model_type: Selects the PolarMACE calculator architecture used by this checkpoint.
_comments.default_dtype: Evaluates the model in float32, matching the precision of this checkpoint.
_comments.instructions: Contains options interpreted by the i-PI MACE wrapper rather than by the MACE model constructor.
_comments.compute_BEC: Computes Born effective charges and the proper piezoelectric tensor by automatic differentiation.
_comments.ignore: Skips copying unused optional model outputs from the device to CPU; required energy, force, stress, dipole, BEC, and piezoelectric data remain available.
